comments.body:
"Bardiche"
Can be found in the "Escort ship for the Arctic sea surveyors" shipwreck located in the East Kara Sea (which can also give iron plated lamellar armor). Stats:

+1 Swordplay
+1 Swordmastery
+1 Assault
8k fame to equip, Memorial Album item

Images: eririndol.blog.fc2.com/blog-date-201402.html

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Yep, what it lacks in stats, it more than makes up for in... how awesome it... looks. Funny, I could swear this item didn't have its proper name added to the DB back when I posted those stats. More ninja stealth updates to the UWO DB? I wonder.
